metadata.title: Agent API graph directory
metadata.authorityBoundary: Deterministic public-source joins only. Exact IDs and source-declared relationships are authoritative; normalized-label and account-title joins are explicitly derived and never presented as universal federal crosswalks.

entities.label: House Armed Services Subcommittee on Cyber, Information Technologies, and Innovation jurisdiction
entities.claim: Department of Defense policy related to the acquisition of computer software, the electromagnetic spectrum, and electromagnetic warfare; and Department of Defense policy and programs and accounts related to artificial intelligence, cyber security, cyber operations, cyber forces, information technology, and science and technology (including defense-wide programs and accounts related to research, development, testing, and evaluation, except for those defense-wide programs and accounts related to research, development, testing, and evaluation of missile defense systems).

entities.label: House Armed Services Subcommittee on Intelligence and Special Operations jurisdiction
entities.claim: Department of Defense policy and programs and accounts related to military intelligence, national intelligence, countering weapons of mass destruction, counter-proliferation, counter-terrorism, other sensitive military operations, special operations forces, information operations policy and military information support operations, and security cooperation.

entities.label: House Armed Services Subcommittee on Strategic Forces jurisdiction
entities.claim: Department of Defense and Department of Energy policy related to strategic deterrence, strategic stability, nuclear weapons, strategic and nuclear arms control, non-proliferation, nuclear safety, missile defense, and space; Department of Defense programs and accounts related to nuclear weapons, strategic missiles, nuclear command and control systems, Department of Defense intelligence space, space systems and services of the military departments, and intermediate and long-range missile defense systems; and Department of Energy national security programs and accounts.

entities.label: Senate Appropriations Subcommittee on Defense jurisdiction
entities.claim: Defense appropriations

entities.label: U.S. Special Operations Command mission
entities.claim: USSOCOM headquarters at MacDill Air Force Base develops and provides special operations forces and capabilities for national defense.

entities.label: U.S. Special Operations Command published budget portfolio
entities.claim: Published budget sponsorship covers 68 retained defense program records.

entities.label: Defense Contract Management Agency mission
entities.claim: Contract administration and acquisition oversight, with its own operating procurements. Contracts managed for others are not DCMA buying power.

entities.label: Office of the Secretary of Defense mission
entities.claim: Department-level policy, resources and program offices. OSD budget accounts and WHS-executed procurement overlap and must not be summed.

entities.label: Defense Legal Services Agency mission

entities.label: Pentagon Force Protection Agency mission
entities.claim: Pentagon and associated facilities protection. Requirements are served by WHS contracting; Pentagon Reservation fund scope must not be mistaken for PFPA-only buying power.

entities.label: AFRL — Kirtland mission
entities.claim: Directed Energy and Space Vehicles directorates at Kirtland Air Force Base. AFRL announced an enterprise redesign in April 2026 without site closures or relocations; this remains a site-level record.

entities.label: AFRL — Rome Research Site mission
entities.claim: AFRL research presence at Rome. The April 2026 enterprise redesign incorporates the former Information Directorate into Information and Spectrum Warfare; this node represents the research site, not the entire directorate.

entities.label: AFRL — Eglin Research Site mission
entities.claim: AFRL research presence at Eglin. The April 2026 enterprise redesign incorporates the former Munitions Directorate into Air Warfare; this node represents the research site, not the entire directorate.
